name: Form Finding: Rules, Constraints and Possible Shapes
v1_note: Six-hall route after Forces. Descent has a controlled desktop-verified primary; later halls require source and spatial review before their claims are treated as demonstrated.
truth: A chosen update, objective and set of constraints make some configurations accessible. An accepted endpoint depends on the model and its stopping rule.
qfep_connection: Compare how models define a cost, constrain variation and accept an endpoint. This is a methodological connection; the exhibits do not establish that physical energy, numerical objective and variational free energy are interchangeable.
learning_objectives: Measure a local gradient and distinguish three stopping conditions
Investigate how supports, length and load constrain a cable
Compare local relaxation rules for a connected shape
Investigate uphill proposals and the limits of escaping local minima
Author a model by choosing its objective, constraints and stopping rule

deferred_reason.Chamber_FormFinding: chambers removed from the spine (Palle, 2026-09-02): the catalyst chambers leave the walk; the map stays on disk

content: FormFinding_Descent: where does downhill take you, and why does it stop?
FormFinding_Catenary: what changes between held endpoints?
FormFinding_Relaxation: how do local constraints change a connected shape?
FormFinding_Equilibrium: what balances, and is the balance stable?
FormFinding_Annealing: what can accepting an uphill move make accessible?
FormFinding_Forge: which objective, constraints and stopping rule will you author?
